# Single radio button

Figma: `Single radio button`, node `66:1541` (page Components, `1:28`).
4 variants - `selected[2]` x `state[2]`.

The 20px dial on its own, with no label. Figma ships it as its own component set and
[Radio button](Radio.md) composes an instance of it, so it has its own class here.

Use this directly only where there is no label - a row selector in a table, for example.
Anywhere a label belongs, use `Radio button`, which gives you the clickable label row.

## Markup

The dial takes its state from a sibling input, so it needs one, and the input must be its
**immediately preceding sibling** - the selected and disabled styling is driven by `+`.

```html
<input type="radio" name="rows" class="v27-choice-input" id="row-7" />
<label for="row-7" class="v27-visually-hidden-label">Select row 7</label>
<span class="v27-radio-box"></span>
```

The dot is drawn with a pseudo-element, so the box takes no children and needs no asset.
An unlabelled dial still needs an accessible name; never ship one without.

## Classes

| Class | What it is |
|---|---|
| `.v27-radio-box` | the 20px dial |
| `.v27-choice-input` | the real input, visually hidden but focusable - shared with Checkbox |

## Values

| Variant | Fill | Border | Dot | Figma node |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Selected=No, State=Default` | `Background/Primary` | 1px `Border/Input bold` | none | `66:1539` |
| `Selected=Yes, State=Default` | `Background/Primary` | 1px `Border/Input bold` | 14px `Foreground/Primary` | `66:1540` |
| `Selected=No, State=Disabled` | `Background/Tertiary` | 1px `Border/Bold` | none | `66:1670` |
| `Selected=Yes, State=Disabled` | `Background/Tertiary` | 1px `Border/Bold` | 14px `Neutral/400` | `66:1668` |

Dial 20px (`--v27-size-s`), dot 14px, radius 15px - the radius is off the Radius scale and
is Figma's value for a circle, so it is a literal.

The border stays when selected; only the dot appears. That differs from Single Checkbox,
where the border is dropped entirely on selection.

See FINDINGS.md #22 (primitive bound where a semantic role exists) and #23 (this component
and its own instance disagree about the fill).

## All classes in this component

`.v27-choice-input`, `.v27-radio-box`
